notes.title: Discover New Dimensions in UNFATED
notes.content:
Greetings, survivors! 👋 

We are excited to announce that our next major update of the UNFATED game is ready. 

⚡️Get ready for new challenges and discoveries that will greatly enrich your game world. 

Here's what we've prepared:

1. New Location - Desert: Embark on a journey through vast and mystical sands, where every step could lead to unexpected events. Feel the heat of the dunes and uncover forgotten secrets hidden among them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/b843c39e842c980ffbfbe7f630544b18ea94acc1.png

2. Dead Zone: This dangerous and gloomy area will test your mettle. Deadly traps, unpredictable enemies, and unique resources all await you in the Dead Zone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/96b9814b6a2a356aad0df4f5ac6faa8b30fd52b2.jpg

3. Urban: Explore the updated streets and buildings, where each corner comes to life and tells its story. New quests, characters, and mysteries make the city an even more captivating place for exploration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/ecdb5638b9fb9ca92a8267db51d49b9ce7db152c.png

4. Separate Locations: New exploration zones include underground labyrinths and snowy landscapes, each with its own features, quests, and surprises.

5. All Vehicles Added: Now you can travel the world of UNFATED in any vehicle. Simply approach the door and use the teleport to access transportation. 🚘

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/96fbb85a8560ac2f24e72ca85fc773bae6a042be.png

6. Improved Vehicle Handling: We've listened to your feedback and improved the handling of vehicles, making rides even more enjoyable and realistic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/9767db0e6e46bbc5c6777a478e19c30241d83257.png

7. Optimized Water Immersion: Improved water physics and character reaction to immersion, adding more realism and fluidity.

8. Enhanced AI and Damage System: Enemy AI has become more sophisticated, and the damage system more accurate, making combat even more thrilling.

9. Optimization and Performance Improvements: All locations are now configured for Distance Culling and Cull Distance Volume, significantly improving game performance. Additionally, integration with World Partition ensures an even smoother and more optimized gaming session.

We thank you for your unwavering support and hope you'll appreciate all the new features. Invite friends, explore the updated world of UNFATED, and Wishlist now on Steam!

Fight for tomorrow! 💥

➡️Check out our social networks: Twitter, Youtube, Discord

notes.title: UNFATED's Latest Update: A Leap Forward in Survival Gaming!
notes.content:
Hello, Survivors!

We're thrilled to see your ongoing support and enthusiasm for UNFATED. Your journey with us is about to get even more exciting with our latest game update. Let's dive into what's new and improved!

 Major Game Enhancements:

Our development team has made significant strides in updating UNFATED. The new version of the game has evolved tremendously, offering a richer and more immersive experience. We can't wait for you to see the changes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/375792b48bfdc13af1f9dc47731a9ea35c1614c3.png


 Build and Craft Like Never Before:

We've expanded your survival toolkit. Now, you can construct homes, craft items, and receive and complete missions from NPCs. The game's crafting and building elements have been significantly enhanced, offering a plethora of new possibilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/8196dade3fc86f45645dd8e398338887693929f8.png

New Aiming and Movement Features:

Gain more control and flexibility with the ability to switch aiming from right to left shoulder, and lean left or right for strategic cover. Navigate the terrain more fluidly with the ability to leap over fences and small objects, climb onto various surfaces for tactical advantages, and swim in watery areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/fa2b36f65dbe10f324ce39a9fe43d4a6a73497cd.png

Explore New Locations and Dynamics:
Get ready to explore new foggy terrains that add mystery and challenge to your journey. Remember, construction is limited to natural landscapes - no building on asphalt, roads, or within city limits. The forest is now your canvas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/77f85ff982abaafd81659ebec1ff57147280fc53.png


 Day and Night Cycle:

Experience the dynamic cycle of day and night in UNFATED. Equip your flashlight for the dangers that lurk after dark and enjoy the realistic ebb and flow of time that adds depth to your survival quest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/abd48b42890c1b443ff9e3e8567345ba2d424463.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/30da3437802133a21b421f46ba1cce39ba1ceac4.png

 Melee Combat and Enhanced Arsenal:

We're bringing the thrill of melee combat to UNFATED. Get your hands on new melee weapons like axes, pickaxes, and bats, and prepare for close-quarters combat!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/37e742742f234e0eedfb1ea8c3794b92b4fc4e2a.png

Behind the scenes, we've been hard at work:

🗺️ The map has been completely revamped.
⚡️ Graphics quality has nearly doubled.
🚀 Performance has been enhanced for smoother gameplay.
Every aspect of the game, from roads to fields, now flows with a refined logic. We've smoothed out every detail, refining mechanics and improving the AI for a more immersive experience.

Prepare to be drawn deeper into the world of UNFATED with these updates. We're elevating your gaming experience to new heights and can't wait for you to join us on this enhanced journey of survival!

Check out our social networks: Twitter, Youtube, Discord

notes.title: Uncover the Secrets of UNFATED - Post-Apocalyptic Survival Awaits
notes.content:
Greetings, UNFATED Survivors!

Dive into "UNFATED", a game where post-apocalyptic America faces an alien threat not from distant stars, but from within our own planet

UNFATED" portrays post-apocalyptic America after an alien attack, not by distant extraterrestrials, but by an advanced civilization known as 'Outlanders', hidden behind Antarctica's ice wall. Known to only a few, these "Outlanders" have been part of Earth's history, often mistaken for space aliens.  Despite a catastrophic defeat in this war, remnants of the army and civilian survivors persist in resistance, seeking answers to the Outlanders' motives and the cause of their attack.

UNFATED World - A Glimpse into the Unknown:

Discover a vast world with 6 unique zones: 

1. Urban
2. Countryside/Forest 
3. Desert 
4. Antarctica
5. Radioactive Zone
6. Underground.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/e9e8ec6c0cbc809a7b6c032904d37fb808db7a92.png

⚡️Navigate a city overrun by alien flora that sprawls across buildings, with a hidden spaceship looming overhead.
⚡️Explore the countryside, rich in resources and moderately dangerous, perfect for building your new home.
⚡️Venture into the desert, scattered with military remnants and open to construction, but beware of its exposed battlegrounds.
⚡️Enter the radioactive zone, offering unique resources leading to special items, accessible only with the proper gear.
⚡️Face the ultimate challenge in Antarctica, whether on a solitary journey or a team quest, to complete one of the game's key missions.

Gameplay - Survival at its Core:

- Start in the safety of the Resistance Bunker, prove your worth, and gear up with basic supplies.
- Your mission: gather resources, eliminate alien enemies, and trade trophies for better equipment and construction blueprints.
- Encounter other players - ally or fight. Death means losing your items, which can be picked up by others.
- Build and upgrade your shelters in forest and desert zones, create storage for your resources, but stay alert to enemy raids.

VEHICLES

UNFATED offers 11 vehicles:

-3 off-road vehicles
-1 buggy
-1 ATV
-1 mountain bike
-3 cars
-1 snowmobile (available only in winter)
-1 horse

Each vehicle has its own distinct characteristics. Players can use the vehicle's trunk to transport resources. Vehicles are available for purchase in shops using gestones, though some require specific items found on the map. Owning a garage in your home is essential for vehicle purchases. Additionally, for a fee, vehicles can be delivered to any location on the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/ef0075fc4a18e9d404422a3f1587505faa7e02d5.png

Crafting, Resources, and Transport

- Scavenge for food, water, ammo, and crafting items across the map.
- Utilize crafting to create ammunition, medicines, and food.
- Choose from a variety of transport options, each with unique features, to navigate the treacherous terrain.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638181/8196dade3fc86f45645dd8e398338887693929f8.png

CONSTRUCTION
In "UNFATED", build houses in forest and desert zones, with red and green highlights indicating non-buildable and buildable areas, respectively. Utilize blueprints to upgrade wooden, stone, and metal structures, with larger ones needing more resources. Your house can include workbenches for weapon mods, storage chests, and electricity generators. Host up to 3 friends, and respawn there after death, or at the resistance bunker if you don't have a home. Beware of raids from other players, reinforcing the need for stronger structures.

"UNFATED" offers an intense survival experience where every choice matters. From fierce ground battles to strategic resource management, every action shapes your journey in this alien-invaded world. Will you uncover the reason behind the attack and what the aliens seek from humanity?

Join us in "UNFATED" to unravel the mystery and fight for humanity's future!
Сheck out more content on our Twitter

UNFATED Team.
